notes.title: Localization and Demo!
notes.content:
[p]Hello all lovely Collectamon Players![/p]

[h3]Another small development update![/h3]

[h2]Localization[/h2]

Implementing localization has nearly finished. Seeing as this is my first game I didn't think about it while starting development on this game. And oh my is it a chore to retroactively go through every text field in the game and add localization. That said I've done just that and it seems everything is finished on that part(although I might encounter a few missed once during further testing).
The languages I am currently localizing are:

[i]- French
- Italian
- German
- Spanish
- Dutch
[/i]
[h2]Demo[/h2]

I am preparing a demo so people who want to try the game can do this before deciding whether they want to buy the game!

[h2]ETA[/h2]

I hope to be able to release both localization and the demo next weekend.
If I don't make this it will be the weekend after that.

Lastly, huge thanks to Pochoclo for helping me with the Spanish translation!

Have a great day!

notes.title: Update 0.3 - The Desert Update
notes.content:
Hello again all lovely Collectamon players!

The Desert update is here!

[h1]What's new?[/h1]

[h2]New Area[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485484/dddc83ad8e58d8d04ba2b22aae472fa9e107c287.gif[/img]
The Desert area is now unlockable from the Sanctuary. The third area in the game. You will find new monsters here, a new boss and you might be hit by a sandstorm during your adventure here.

[h2]17 New Monsters[/h2]

There are 17 new monsters that have been added. 16 of these are found in the desert including 1 boss.

The Toxic Swamp now also has a boss which makes for 17 total.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485484/b5ff96d248b0e19e2e504e8da17e7557b66db589.png[/img]
[h2]Sanctuary Rework[/h2]

One of the early points of feedback to the game was that the sanctuary was quite tedious to manage. After some thinking I made the decision to rework the Sanctuary. You will now be able to place your monsters in the Sanctuary without having to worry about tedious building management. 
Roam free my lovely Collectamon!

[h2]Power Orbs?[/h2]

There is a new system in place which will have monsters rarely dropping power orbs.
See for yourself what they do when you collect them!

[h2]More Upgrade levels and slight rebalance[/h2]

A lot of upgrades have had their caps increased and the higher levels balanced slightly.

[h2]Achievement & Steam Achievement Rework[/h2]

With a new update of course come new achievements. There are a few that have been added.
I noticed that some of the current Steam achievement are just an annoying grind and not that fun to obtain. For this reason I removed those from Steam(they are still obtainable in game) so all you Steam achievement hunters can have a more fun experience completing this games achievement hunt.


Last of all a quick note about save files. They have been reset. But fear not, your shinies have been saved and will be retrievable in an upcoming update

notes.title: Update 0.3 Development Update - Desert, More Bosses & Sanctuary Rework
notes.content:
Hello Dear Collectamon Players,

Once again it has been a while.
Unfortunately I have not found as much time as I would like to work on Collectamon.
This does not mean however that work isn't being done because it most certainly is. I'd even go as far as saying I am managing pick up pace again even though I'm doing this next to my full-time job.

I will go through the things I have been working and that will be in update 0.3 - The Desert Update.

[h1]The Desert Area[/h1]

The Desert area will feature 15 new monsters just like the previous areas. All the artwork for these is done and now only implementation remains.

The first draft of the area itself is also done, here is a quick preview for you all! :D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485484/dddc83ad8e58d8d04ba2b22aae472fa9e107c287.gif[/img]


[h1]Bosses[/h1]

The plan is to add 2 more bosses to the game. both the Toxic Swamp and the Desert will get one. The artwork for these is still in progress.

[h1]Sanctuary rework[/h1]

I have received a lot of feedback on the Sanctuary being incredibly tedious. The gathering of essence and placing of buildings just was not as fun as it should be. Besides it being not fun for you guys it was also one of the areas of development I least enjoyed working on due to lots of issues arising with the building system both technically and balancing-wise. This is why I decided on reworking it!

What does this mean?

I will be removing the buildings from the game entirely. Instead of placing your monsters in habitats you will be placing them in the Sanctuary area itself where they will all roam freely.
The gathering of essence is still something I am thinking about in terms of design. I will make sure this is not as tedious and time-consuming as it was previously.

Now you may ask youself what will happen to all the buildings I bought and the monsters I caught...
I will have perform a full save reset for this update. But fear not!!! Your shiny and shimmering Collectamon will be sent to the LOST SHINY REALM!. in short they will be stripped from your previous save file and sent to an area where you will be able to catch them again :)

[h1]Mutliple Save Files[/h1]

Now here is a feature no one requested but I though would be nice to add. You will simply have 3 seperate save files with seperate progress instead of one now. The version you're seeing below is still W.I.P and the UI will be improved upon a bit before the update is released.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485484/35fa17b12022cce8a55fe6bf1f7940f1447e301c.png[/img]


[h2]Devlog[/h2]

Just a small little update on something that I am trying to find time for as well. I am currently working on an idea to do a devlog to show a bit of what's happening on the development side of things. I will post about this as well once it is done.

[h2]Sneak peak[/h2]

Lastly a little sneak peak at one of the new Collectamon as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485484/fc133f88423a15157ce43e2999541687b10a4baf.png[/img]

That's all folks. Thanks again for your patience. <3

Have a nice day!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.2
notes.content:
Hello again all lovely Collectamon players!

The time is finally here!
Once again it took a bit longer than expeced bit the update is finally done.

First of all this definitely is not required but I do recommend everyone to start with a new save.

[h1]What's new?[/h1]

[h2]A Boss Battle![/h2]

Catch monsters  in the appropriate area to earn a boss summoning item and spawn the boss. Be sure to prepare well for it is a tough fight

[h2]A Mastery System[/h2]

Catch a lot of the same monsters to gain stat bonusses!(After building the Stone of Mastery in your Sanctuary)

[h2]Higher upgrade levels![/h2]

All upgrades can now be upgraded even higher!

[h2]A whole lot of new Achievements[/h2]

I added a whole lot of new achievements to collect and removed some that were unfairly RNG based and time-consuming as well

[h2]Sad news :([/h2]

Unfortunately the artist working with me won't be able to draw for some time so progress will be quite slow moving forward.

I do however plan to work on less art intenstive stuff such as:

[i]- Quality of life features
- Controller Support
- Localization
[/i]

[h3]QA credit[/h3]

Thanks Zithis for helping me thoroughly test the earlier versions of update 0.2!

Again thanks for your patience everone and have fun exploring the update!

notes.title: Update 0.12a - Hotfix
notes.content:
[h1]UPDATE 0.12a[/h1]

Yesterday a bug came to light that needed quick fixing. Also added a small amount of quality of life features.

[h3]Additions[/h3]

- Added a "reclaim all" button to the settings menu. This button is added for all players who lost monsters due to a bug in the Sanctuary. It removes all monsters from all habitats and reclaims the ones lost due to the bug as well.(also comes in handy when you want to remove all monster for other reasons)
- Sorting. When adding monsters to habitats they will be sorted by monster ID. More sorting options are planned for sometime in the future.

[h3]Fixes[/h3]

- Fixed bug mentioned above where leaving the Sanctuary and quitting could cause monsters placed in habitats to be lost
- Fixed a pillar in the Toxic Swamp that didn't have its cost properly configured.
- Fixed a habitat placement bug that caused habitats to be placed on exiting Sanctuary.


[h3]QA Credit[/h3]

Moglorosh & Zithis. Thanks again for helping me find the bug and test the bug fix!

That's all folks!

notes.title: Update 0.2 Development Update - Mastery & Boss
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485484/725a9e982d4bfa99e61b0600e9cb57983ce8c0b9.jpg[/img]
Hello all lovely Collectamon players!

It's been a while since the last update and I would like to assure everyone we're still hard at work to update the game!

I would love to update you all on the progress we are making :D

[h2]Mastery System[/h2]

I have been working on creating a mastery system where you can gain stats for catching the same Collectamon a certain amount of times. I am very curious to see what everyone thinks of it and would really appreciate as much feedback on the system as possible. In my opinion it is a system that is still very much subject change depending on the feedback we receive.


[i]W.I.P Screenshot of the Monster Log with the Mastery System[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485484/cc8b8089d26996a2227a48702db9e580f463d4ed.jpg[/img]

[h2]A Boss Monster?![/h2]

Yes! A boss monster will be added to the game, There are plans of creating one for every area.
I will not be going in to depth on the specifics of the boss mechanics and system for now seeing as I want to test some more out before acquiring feedback.


[i]Below you can see the stages of art for the boss from rough pen sketch to the near final digital colorless version.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485484/11d814a0cc2ff1380543070095e608f9ef6894c2.png[/img]

That's it for now with this development update!

Thanks for your patience everyone!

<3

notes.title: Update 0.11b
notes.content:
[h1]Huge Thanks[/h1]
[i]Patch notes below
[/i]
First of all I would like tot thank everyone who has played Collectamon over the last (nearly)2 months. This is my very first game release and it truly fills me with joy to see people enjoying the game!

Special thanks to everyone who supported me during development and release.

Extra special thanks to [b]Argl[/b] who helped me out a lot during development, release and post-release on all fronts.
And lastly I'd like to thank [b]Zithis[/b] who helped me playtest this patch.

[h1]UPDATE 0.11b[/h1]

[h2]Additions
[/h2]
- Added a sanctuary indicator
- Added ability to toggle UI in Options menu(previously only done by pressing "O")
- Added Total Essence Per Second to habitat UI instead of only showing it per monster
- Added Claim button to missions and additional visuals to make it more clear to new players they are there.
- Added current upgrade level to upgrades.

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]

- Changed Toxic Swamp Unlock cost from 5000 > 7500

[h2]Fixes
[/h2]
- Removed the possibity to lock yourself on the area unlock mission
- Fix for the monster being unable to be caught after a long time of playing(ghost monsters)
- Fixed not being able to build anymore after re-entering the Sanctuary
